title: Add public self-host acceptance gate

context.summary: Add a final public-ready self-host acceptance command that ties together installer, runtime, backup, CLI, MCP, Hermes and uninstall checks.
context.background: Mindory now has the runnable local MVP, installer, public repository hygiene, real model adapters, multimodal pipelines, S3 storage and backup/restore. The final public gate should make the supported self-host path explicit and reproducible.

in: Add a self-host acceptance script with a dry-run default and an opt-in live Docker mode.
Dry-run validation must cover clean temp home, installer plan/prepare, disabled/local model modes, upload fixtures, jobs, search/context, CLI, MCP, Hermes, backup and uninstall steps.
Live mode must run installer startup against a temporary MINDORY_HOME, run MVP acceptance, create a backup, stop the stack and uninstall.
Document the final public self-host acceptance commands and support boundaries.
Update repository status, support matrix, changelog and validation gates.
out: Mandatory live Docker acceptance in the default pnpm check path.

acceptance_criteria: Root package exposes a public self-host acceptance command.
Default self-host acceptance runs without Docker mutation outside a temporary MINDORY_HOME.
The acceptance script documents and validates the full supported public flow: install, disabled/local model modes, upload fixtures, jobs, search/context, CLI, MCP, Hermes, backup and uninstall.
Opt-in live mode can run installer start, MVP acceptance, backup, stack reset and uninstall in a temporary home.
Docs describe this command as the public-ready gate and keep production-grade gaps as future work.

manual_checks: Confirm live acceptance remains opt-in and does not run by default in pnpm check.
Confirm docs do not claim SaaS-grade production readiness.

risks: Live self-host acceptance can be slow because it may build images and start Docker Compose.
Local model profile acceptance depends on available Docker resources.
The public gate must be explicit about what is supported versus future production operations.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
